currency.basis: The branding page is the current official publication and its logomark matches the currently served favicon/apple-touch-icon design (retrieved 2026-10-04).

identity.basis: Asset is served from solana.com's own branding page, the official domain for the Solana record (Company.id 16067, url solana.com).

assessment.independenceRationale: One official primary publication (solana.com brand page) plus its served favicon/touch-icon corroborate within the same official source; no independent third party was needed because the official domain directly serves the standalone asset.

variant.basis: The standalone logomark (gradient bars, transparent) is the current official icon-only variant; no white-on-gradient-circle variant is published on any official surface checked.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All three bars with their beveled corners and per-bar gradient positions survive; no lost detail in the final Desktop renders on either theme.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The wide three-bar mark fills the square cell with balanced margins after no transform; it remains recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes.
candidate.rationale: Replace the undocumented white-on-gradient-circle avatar with the official standalone Solana logomark published on the official brand page and mirrored by every current official favicon surface.
candidate.role: standalone logomark (icon-only variant) from the official Solana brand assets
transforms: No geometric transform, scaling or backing added; source viewBox 0 0 101 88 preserved as-is
SVGO (repository svgo.config.mjs): 2519 -> 1808 bytes; render difference at most 1/255 per channel on both themes (gradient re-serialization antialiasing); selected the optimized result as final.svg
candidate.variant: current gradient branding: three bars with #9945FF to #19FB9B gradient on a transparent background; no backing field added
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: The accepted icon is a white-glyph-on-gradient-circle avatar; the replacement is the official gradient logomark on transparent. Colors invert from white-bars to gradient-bars and the circular field is removed, matching the official current variant.

proposals.reason: The official Solana brand page (solana.com/branding) publishes the gradient three-bar logomark on transparent as the standalone mark, and every current official surface (apple-touch-icon, favicon, explorer favicon) uses gradient bars on dark/transparent. The accepted icon.svg is a white-bars-on-gradient-circle avatar presentation for which no first-party official evidence exists (no official Solana app on Play; branding page lists no such variant). Replacing the undocumented ecosystem avatar with the official current logomark is a source-supported correction.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector (official solanaLogoMark.svg, plain SVG paths with gradient, no raster) of the current official standalone Solana mark; the accepted icon is an undocumented third-party avatar presentation whose colors invert the official design.

sources.observation: Official Brand & Press page lists SVG brand assets (logo, logomark, vertical, wordmark, foundation) as gradient-on-transparent variants; fetched solanaLogoMark.svg (2519 bytes, viewBox 0 0 101 88, gradient #9945FF→#8752F3→#5497D5→#43B4CA→#28E0B9→#19FB9B).
Official apple-touch-icon (180x180 PNG) shows gradient bars on black, not the white-on-gradient-circle avatar; corroborates that the accepted icon's presentation is not the current official variant.
